verdict.rationale: Kong has a dedicated AI Gateway product with explicit LLM/MCP traffic governance features: multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.), token/rate limiting, semantic security/prompt guards, MCP traffic security, observability, and auto-generation of MCP servers from APIs, all documented as first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI-gateway-specific features (community evidence only covers core gateway routing bugs, not AI/MCP governance).
